texto: Hello! I'm Beto, the robot. Today I'm going to teach you a secret of robots and computers.
An algorithm is a list of steps, one after another, to do something.
It's like a cooking recipe. First we mix.
Then we bake.
And in the end we have a cake!
You already use algorithms every day. Look, to brush your teeth:
First, you take the toothbrush.
Then, you put on the toothpaste.
After that, you brush your teeth.
And at the end, you rinse your mouth.
What if you put on your shoes first and then your socks?
How funny! That doesn't work.
Socks first, and then shoes. The steps must go in the right order.
Robots do exactly what you tell them, step by step.
I can move forward, turn right and turn left.
You will be the programmer, and I will follow your commands. Let's play!
Put the steps in order to brush your teeth. Tap the first one!
Very good! First, take the toothbrush. Then, put on the toothpaste. Then, brush your teeth. Finally, rinse your mouth
Help the seed grow. What do you do first?
Very good! First, dig a little hole. Then, put in the seed. Then, add water. Finally, the flower grows
I'm hungry! Put the steps of the sandwich in order.
Very good! First, put on the bread. Then, add the cheese. Then, cover with another bread. Finally, time to eat
That's it!
Very good!
Yes!
Hmm, that one doesn't go first. What do you do at the start?
Not that one yet. What comes next?
Beto wants to reach the flag. Tap the arrow to make him move forward. He needs two steps!
Tap forward twice and then the green button.
Now the flag is farther away! Count the squares.
Count how many squares there are to the flag.
Beto passes by the star and picks it up. Then he goes to the flag!
If you move forward to the flag, you pass by the star.
Now Beto knows how to turn. The curved arrow button makes him turn to his right.
Move forward twice, turn right and move forward two more times.
Now we have to go up. Turn left.
Move forward twice, turn left and move forward twice.
Pick up the star in the corner and then go down to the flag.
First go right all the way to the end, then turn to go down.
There is a rock in the way. Beto cannot go over it. Go around it!
Go up, move forward, and go down after passing the rock.
What a long way. Use the repeat button! Tap repeat three, and then forward.
Repeat six times and move forward. Just one block!
Use repeat to move forward a lot, then turn and go down.
Repeat six, turn right, repeat two.
A big board with two stars. You can do it!
Repeat four, turn right, repeat four.
Go up and down like on a staircase. Move forward, turn, move forward, turn.
Forward, right, forward, left... the pattern repeats!
The last challenge. There is a wall. Find the way underneath. You are a great programmer!
Go down, pass under the wall and go back up.
First give Beto some instructions. Tap the arrows.
Use the repeat button to do it with fewer blocks!
That's a lot of steps. Remove some.
Oops! Beto bumped into something. Check the steps and try again.
You made it, but you missed collecting a star. Try again!
Beto hasn't reached the flag yet. Almost! Add more steps.
Repeat 2 times. Now choose what to repeat.
Repeat 3 times. Now choose what to repeat.
Repeat 4 times. Now choose what to repeat.
Repeat 5 times. Now choose what to repeat.
Repeat 6 times. Now choose what to repeat.
Hello! I'm Beto. Tap the glowing path to start.
Great to see you again! Let's continue where you left off.
You completed everything! You are a great programmer. You can replay the levels.
Choose the glowing path.
You did it!
Awesome!
You are a great programmer!
Wow, well done!
Excellent work!
Fantastic!
Three stars!
